dedupe_keys.name: high quality annotations of power infrastructure in rural ontario

description: High Quality Annotations of Power Infrastructure in Rural Ontario is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Kevin Dick, Francois Charih. We used the Systematic Street View Sampler (S^3) to acquire 18,883 sampled Google Street View images throughout the rural areas of southern Ontario. We then leveraged the Amazon Mechanical Turk annotation environment to obtain high confidence annotations of whether the images contain power-related infrastructure or not. Coverage: southern Ontario. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
